principles.principle: Focus on user behavior, not implementation details
Cover all acceptance criteria from user story
Include positive, negative, and edge cases

boundaries.rule: Spec files must be in specs/ directory
Seed tests must be in tests/ directory

validation.rule: After creating spec, verify all acceptance criteria covered
Check scenarios are clear and actionable

step.name: parse_story
step.description: Extract key elements from user story

step.name: identify_scenarios
step.description: Identify test scenarios from acceptance criteria

guidance.rule: Each acceptance criterion should have at least one test scenario
Include happy path for each criterion
Include edge cases for boundary conditions

step.name: define_steps
step.description: Define clear steps for each scenario

guidance.rule: Use numbered lists for sequential actions
Be specific about what the user does

step.name: define_results
step.description: Define expected results for each scenario

guidance.rule: Use bullet points for multiple results
